dedupe_keys.name: abu dhabi department of energy annual technical report for the water wastewater electricity and district cooling sector

description: The Department of Energy of Abu Dhabi, the sector regulator, produced an annual technical report for the water, wastewater, electricity and district cooling sector of the emirate. The 2021 edition gives water demand growth, desalination capacity and production by company and technology, plant reliability, water transmission and distribution assets, distribution losses, supply pressure and water quality compliance of the distribution companies, customer numbers, sewer network length and collapses and blockages per 100 km, trade effluent consents, recycled water assets and reuse, biosolids and health, safety and environmental incidents, alongside the electricity and district cooling chapters. Coverage is the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. The 77-page report is a free PDF in English on the DoE site; no licence is stated. Caveats: the figures are regulatory summaries by company in charts and tables, not a machine-readable dataset, and only the 2021 edition was read. Simulation uses: desalination capacity, distribution losses and sewer failure rates for capacity planning and resilience studies of an arid-region water system. Related records: the SUEN benchmarking of Turkish metropolitan water utilities (data-suen-turkiye-metropolitan-water-utility-benchmarking).
